title: 第371章 正史观影如懿传有难题看我手动解决7第370章 正史观影如懿传有难题看我手动解决6
content_zh:
看着辩驳的人，太子直接反问道：“慈爱？她要是真爱你，在先帝说‘朕之第一子’，抹杀你的存在时，为何不阻止？”
作为‘佟半朝’领事人的佟国维很明白，他们佟佳氏能有今日，依赖于皇帝外甥的愧疚和思母，若是他与佟佳氏生出隔阂，那么......
“皇上，皇权至高无上，孝康章皇后自然不敢挑衅，她对您的爱毋庸置疑，求您明鉴啊！”
“舅舅放心，朕自然明白额娘的心思，您安心就是。”
作为这天下最了解皇上脾气秉性的存在，太子很清楚，虽然这时候他没信，但心里却成功扎进了一根刺，等日后发作起来，或许会有意料之外的效果呢。本就是随口挑拨，哪怕毫无用处，他也不亏！
【敦亲王胤俄：说来也是泪，我二次从龙的时候，老十七卖兄求荣，害我被圈禁，当时我没有多想，但等知道老十七与甄嬛私通生子后，我悟了。】
？？？
十爷，你悟啥了？
不过四爷，你这头上的绿帽子可真不少啊！
”哈哈哈，老四，勾引太子八哥的乌拉那拉氏、私通宗室太医的甄氏沈氏、和侍卫幕天席地的孙氏、还有学习唐高宗李治的弘时，这么多顶绿帽子，你的头还好吗？可别被这重量给压断了。”
听着老九的冷嘲热讽，胤禛强忍着心头的暴怒，从牙缝中挤出一句话来，“九弟慎言，那是话本，并非事实，你......”
“可是老四，你堵不住悠悠众口啊，只要大家都相信，假的也能成真，绿帽子王的名声，你背定了。”
康熙没理会这群儿子，若有所思的说道：“来人，去给朕整改太医院和侍卫营，天幕上的事，朕不希望发生。”
太子听到这话，不由嗤笑一声，讽刺道：“呵，有用吗？负责侍卫营的隆科多都私通，整改有何用？皇上，依孤看，你头上的帽子也不少，毕竟老四后宫的三瓜两枣，可比不上你那人满为患的后宫。”
这话一出，了解内情的阿哥们不由在心里点了点头。
可不是人满为患吗？听说答应位分的都开始两三人挤一个屋子了，那数量、那年纪......
每次回宫给额娘请安，还要避讳那些年轻的庶母，实在是尴尬啊！
【敦亲王胤俄：老十七、太医、侍卫之所以选择帮老四，是因为老四将后宫妃嫔送给他们陪睡生子，甄氏沈氏就是赤裸裸的证据。这还只是被我发现的，没被发现的还不知道有多少。老四，你就是个软饭男！】
？？？！！！
十爷，你结论你到底是怎么得出的？不过好有道理啊！

“额娘，这该不会是真的吧？你去找阿玛说说，让我免选，我不要入四爷府邸。不、我不要入爱新觉罗家，他们家好可怕啊！”
看着自家女儿神情恍惚的模样，妇人连忙安抚道：“敏儿，你别多想，这只是猜测，不一定是......”
“万一是真的呢？作为兄弟，作为爱新觉罗家的一员，十爷难道还能胡编乱造，抹黑自己家的名声？额娘，您不疼我了吗？呜呜呜。”
妇人：好像确实是，十爷抹黑老对头四爷正常，应该不至于自污家族名声吧？
十爷：那上面的人不是我，癫公颠婆的世界，果然没几个正常人，呜呜呜。
“九哥，那上面不是我，我......”
胤禟看着蠢弟弟，不由拍了拍他的肩膀，安慰道：“俄啊，你自求多福吧，爱新觉罗家的名声，算是被你给造完了。”
胤俄张了张嘴，正想要辩解几句，然而话还未出口，就在毫无防备的情况下，被怒火上头的老四打了一拳。.
content_en:
Looking at the people arguing, the prince asked directly: "Love? If she really loved you, why didn't she stop her when the late emperor said 'my first son' and obliterated your existence?"
As the consul of the 'Tong Banchao', Tong Guowei knew very well that the success of their Tong Jia family depended on the emperor's nephew's guilt and longing for his mother. If there was a gap between him and the Tong Jia family, then...
"Your Majesty, the imperial power is supreme. Queen Xiaokangzhang naturally does not dare to provoke you. There is no doubt about her love for you. Please be clear about it!"
"Uncle, don't worry. I naturally understand your mother's thoughts. You can rest assured."
As the person who knows the emperor's temperament best in the world, the prince knows very well that although he doesn't believe it at this time, he has successfully stabbed a thorn in his heart. When it breaks out in the future, it may have unexpected effects. He was just provoking casually, even if it was useless, he would not lose!
[Prince Yin’e of Dun: It’s true that I cried. When I was a slave to the dragon for the second time, Lao Qi betrayed his brother to seek glory, causing me to be imprisoned. I didn’t think much about it at the time, but after I learned that Lao Qi had an affair with Zhen Huan and had a son, I realized it. 】
? ? ?
Master Shi, what have you realized?
But Fourth Master, you have so many cuckolds on your head!
"Hahaha, fourth child, there are so many cuckolds from the Ulanara family who seduced the prince's eighth brother, the Zhen family and the Shen family who had an affair with the royal family doctor, the Sun family who guarded the sky and the ground, and Hong Shi who learned from Tang Gaozong Li Zhi. Is your head okay with so many cuckolds? Don't be crushed by the weight."
Listening to Lao Jiu's cynicism, Yinzhen suppressed the rage in his heart and squeezed out a sentence through his teeth, "Jiu brother, be careful, that is a story, not the truth. You..."
"But Fourth Brother, you can't stop everyone from talking about it. As long as everyone believes it, a lie can become true. You will definitely bear the reputation of being a cuckold king."
Kangxi ignored the group of sons and said thoughtfully: "Come here and help me rectify the imperial hospital and the guard camp. I don't want what happened on the sky to happen."
When the prince heard this, he couldn't help but sneer and said sarcastically: "Oh, is it useful? Longkoduo, who is in charge of the guard camp, is having an affair. What's the use of rectifying it? Your Majesty, Yi Gu sees that you have a lot of hats on your head. After all, the three melons and two dates in the fourth harem are not as good as your overcrowded harem."
As soon as these words came out, the brothers who knew the inside story couldn't help but nodded in their hearts.
Isn't it overcrowded? I heard that those who agreed to the position started to squeeze into a room with two or three people. The number, age...
Every time I go back to the palace to pay my respects to E Niang, I have to avoid those young concubines. It’s really embarrassing!
[Prince Yin'e of Dun: The reason why Lao Shiqi, the imperial doctor, and the guards chose to help Lao Si was because Lao Si gave them the concubines from the harem to sleep with and have children. The Zhen family and Shen family are the naked evidence. These are just the ones I discovered. I don’t know how many more have not been discovered. Fourth child, you are just a soft-boiled man! 】
? ? ? ! ! !
Master Shi, how did you come to your conclusion? But it makes so much sense!
"Mom, can this be true? You go to Ama and tell me to exempt me from the election. I don't want to enter the fourth master's house. No, I don't want to enter the Aisin Gioro family. Their family is so scary!"
Seeing her daughter's dazed expression, the woman quickly comforted her: "Min'er, don't think too much, this is just a guess, not necessarily..."
"What if it's true? As a brother, as a member of the Aixinjueluo family, how can Master Shi still make up nonsense and smear his family's reputation? Mother, don't you love me anymore? Woo hoo hoo."
Woman: It seems true. It’s normal for the Tenth Master to smear his old enemy, the Fourth Master. He shouldn’t be tarnishing the family’s reputation, right?
Master Ten: The person up there is not me. In this world of crazy people, there are really not many normal people. Boo hoo hoo.
"Brother Ninth, it's not me up there, I..."
Yinzhen looked at his stupid brother and couldn't help but patted his shoulder and comforted him: "Oh,You wish yourself a better life, the reputation of the Aixinjueluo family has been completely created by you. "
Yiner opened his mouth and was about to say something in defense. However, before he could say anything, he was unprepared and punched by the angry fourth man. .
